context: The DWPL0, DWPL1, and DWPL2 bits (16-18) of the LoongArch MISC register disable page table entry write protection checks during TLB virtual and real address translation at privilege levels 0, 1, and 2 respectively, preventing store instructions from triggering page modification exceptions on entries with D=0.

|16|DWPL0|RW|Whether to disable the check of the page table entry write protection during TLB virtual and real address translation at the PLV0 privilege level. When this bit is 1, the store instruction will not trigger a page modification exception even if it accesses a page table entry with D=0.|
